name: Intra Position Transfer
definition: Transfer of securities from one sub-balance to another or from one balance status to another.

CollateralAmount.name: Collateral Amount
CollateralAmount.definition: Value of the collateral available for the delivery settlement process.

Reservation.name: Reservation
Reservation.definition: Quantity of securities set aside by a party for specific purpose.

SecuritiesBalance.name: Securities Balance
SecuritiesBalance.definition: Specifies the securities balance or sub-balance from/to which the securities are transferred.
